name: simplify
description: Simplify: aplicación web de finanzas personales para registrar, organizar y analizar ingresos y gastos.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @simplify/shared && concurrently -n shared,api,web -c gray,green,cyan "npm run dev -w @simplify/shared" "npm run dev -w @simplify/api" "npm run dev -w @simplify/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @simplify/shared && npm run build -w @simplify/api && npm run build -w @simplify/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @simplify/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @simplify/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.prod:logs: docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml logs -f nginx api1 api2
scripts.load:humo: docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml --profile load run --rm -e PERFIL=humo k6
scripts.load:carga: docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml --profile load run --rm -e PERFIL=carga k6
scripts.load:estres: docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml --profile load run --rm -e PERFIL=estres k6
